messages:
sam: Hey folks — scheduling a short design review for the API/SDK surface changes tied to the streaming auth header update. Goal: get signoff on the contract and Console UX notes, plus agree on rollout plan. TL;DR — 30m review + 10m buffer for follow-ups.

sam: Pre-read + minimal checklist below. Please react with a time slot or reply if you need more context. I put tentative slots on my calendar as <https://calendar.redwood.com/sam/15m|sam's poll>.

sam: PRE-READ (very short):
- API: header change semantics, backward-compatibility notes (one paragraph)
- SDK: new helper `Client.withStreamingAuth()` usage example
- Console: compact indicator + migration banner text

sam: CHECKLIST (please confirm these before the review):
```
- Add one test for header fallthrough behavior (unit)
- Update SDK docs + example snippet under /docs/streaming-auth
- Console banner copy in figma: v1-ready
- Rollout playbook: canary to dev -> prod with feature flag
```

linh: I can do Fri 11:00–11:40 or Mon 09:00. Will finish unit test today.

kate: Fri 11 works for me. Quick Q: does the SDK change require a major version bump?

omar: leaning Fri too. SDK change is additive (helper) so semver patch if we keep old API. I'll double-check.

jess: I updated the Console banner copy in Figma and linked it in the pre-read doc (see bottom). small nit: suggest "rolling out over 2 weeks" instead of immediate.

sam: @kate good call — plan is no major bump. @omar please confirm by EOD so we can call it. @jess noted on migration timing — we can discuss during review.

omar: confirmed no major bump. patch/minor depending on how we bundle release. :+1:

eng-bot: NOTE: Automated checklist run — CI shows 1 failing lint rule in sdk/streaming-client.ts (line 48).

linh: i'll fix lint now, push in 10.

kate: Fri 11 then. Can someone add me to the calendar invite?

sam: calendar invite sent to the confirmed list. I'll add an agenda doc (5 bullets) and paste it in the thread before the meeting.

jess: quick ask — can we add a rollout rollback command to the playbook? last time it saved us.

sam: yes will add rollback steps + signal metrics to the playbook.

omar: small UX ask: can Console show both old+new header examples in the migration doc? i'll add a snippet.

sam: perfect. If anything blocks, ping me here. Otherwise see y'all Fri 11. :slightly_smiling_face:
